integrity: Exhaustive finite certificates and independent standard-library replay; the order-sixteen example is known and is not claimed as original.
scientific_limitations: All finite abelian groups through order fifteen are exhaustively covered, with a sixteen-vertex witness; no theorem for larger orders, nonabelian groups, graph identification or arbitrary individualization. Literature priority unconfirmed.
title: The sharp sixteen-vertex boundary for one-root orbit refinement of finite abelian Cayley graphs
